title: The Missing page of the report
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：missing　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 missing 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the builder wrote of ① a missing page of the report in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② so missing that nobody in the site would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the missing ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the missing page of the report that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1978 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too missing to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the missing ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a missing boy from the village, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as missing as the boy from the village they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was missing or not, and he said so.

By 1991 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something missing, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite missing; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the missing ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1994, without complaint, she wrote of another missing page of the report in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less missing than anybody had expected. ⑩ The missing boy from the village that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1996, was the one she could never quite name; the missing ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 失踪（前置定语 a missing page of the report：1984 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件失踪的一页）
B. adj. 失踪／缺失（两处加强说法：so missing that … 与 no less missing than …）
C. adj. 失踪／缺失（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 失踪（表语 too missing to do：母亲觉得它太失踪，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 缺失（前置定语 a missing boy from the village：叔叔把整件事称作一桩缺失的男孩）
F. adj. 缺失（同级比较 as missing as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩村里失踪的男孩相比）
G. adj. 缺失（后置定语 something missing：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 缺失（受程度副词修饰 quite missing：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a missing page of the report
the missing page of the report that
a missing boy from the village
The missing boy from the village that

answers.why: missing 意为“失踪”，1984 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件失踪的一页”，此处作前置定语 a missing page of the report。
missing 意为“失踪”，此处用 so missing that 结构，说它失踪到工地里没人敢靠近。
missing 意为“失踪”，施工图上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的失踪报告里缺掉的一页，等于最高级的说法。
missing 意为“失踪”，母亲认为这件东西“太失踪了，谁也用不上”，too missing to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
missing 意为“缺失”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩缺失的男孩”，此处作前置定语 a missing boy from the village。
missing 意为“缺失”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩村里失踪的男孩一样缺失”，同级比较用 as missing as。
missing 意为“缺失”，施工图上那半行字要的是“缺失的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something missing。
missing 意为“缺失”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当缺失”，quite 修饰原级 missing。
missing 意为“缺失”，no less missing than 表示“其缺失不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之缺失不亚于任何人的预料。
missing 意为“缺失”，母亲 1996 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的缺失男孩”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件失踪的一页。（a missing page of the report）
它失踪到工地里没有一个人敢靠近。（so missing that …）
母亲觉得它太失踪，谁也用不上。（too missing to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩缺失的男孩。（a missing boy from the village）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩村里失踪的男孩一样缺失。（as missing as …）
到了 1991 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件缺失的东西。（something missing）
answers: In 1984 the builder wrote of a missing page of the report in the plan.
It was so missing that nobody in the site would go near it.
My mother thought it too missing to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a missing boy from the village.
He said nobody would call it as missing as the boy from the village they had once had.
By 1991 the plan asked for nothing but something missing.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 missing 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the builder wrote of a missing page of the report in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the missing page of the report that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too missing to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a missing boy from the village, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite missing, and everybody laughed.
The missing ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
